svg.title: Red Blue
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Red inverted triangle left and blue upright triangle right form a slanted quadrilateral, as primary printed figure13 shows. Mounting shadow omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=56; record guggenheim1996-essay-56-fig-13; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
